title: 식품위생 분야 종사자의 건강진단 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:01015:20130323:00001:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDA <No. 1015, March 23, 2013>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning Health Examinations) A person who has undergone a health examination under the former Rules on Health Examinations for Workers in Sanitation-related Fields, etc. when these Rules enter into force shall be deemed to have undergone a health examination under these Rules.

Article 3 (Relationship with Other Statutes and Regulations) Where another statute or regulation in force when these Rules enter into force cites the former Rules on Health Examinations for Workers in Sanitation-related Fields, etc. or a provision thereof, and these Rules contain a corresponding provision, the citation shall be deemed to refer to these Rules or the corresponding provision thereof in lieu of the former Rules.
